sloka: धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य रामस्य विदित आत्मनः ।इयम् सा दयिता भार्या राक्षसी वशम् आगता ॥५-१६-१८॥
transliteration: dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ ।iyam sā dayitā bhāryā rākṣasī vaśam āgatā ॥5-16-18॥

translations.english: "She is the loving wife of the righteous, grateful, wise and selfrealised Rama. She has fallen into the hands of these shedemons.
